title: review follow-ups of PR #37889 (AI inquiry page, AppAskPage.tsx)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwGVgec21LwQTtRY85

Filing gate: ③ L1 follow-ups of a landed card's PR (one card per PR, items ticked as done). Source: fleet.
Grading: area:ai · Task · priority:p3 · size S · reach: the AI inquiry page of #37788 (PR #37889), read at L1; none is must-fix (L1-a 7215194705 "Nits", 7216004152 "Nits left for later").
Dedupe: open-issue search `"PR #37889"`: 1 hit before filing, #37858 (the Ask AI button card, which names #37889 only as an overlap); `AppAskPage`: only #37788 and its siblings.

All four are in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AppAskPage.tsx` (re-read on main after #37889 merges; line numbers are not carried here):
- [ ] A transient error on the `?c=` ownership check is read as "foreign" and drops `?c=`; only a definite foreign/other-app answer should fall back to the home state.
- [ ] The `?c=` check downloads the full conversation history to read `metadata`; read the conversation's metadata alone.
- [ ] An app with no `_packageId` gets a page that cannot create a conversation and says nothing; show a clear state instead.
- [ ] Duplicate suggestions warn on React `key`; key them so duplicates render without a warning (or drop exact duplicates).

Acceptance: one test per ticked item, in a new test file named for this card.
